title: Driver preferences editor (lanes table + no-go zones)
description: Build the Preferences tab content for the driver detail page. Three sections matching the carrier_portal_prefernces.png design (adapted for admin view): Preferred Lanes table with add/remove rows (origin state -> dest state, optional city refinement), No-Go Zones chip list with add/remove (state, optional city), and basic scheduling fields (home base city/state, max days out). All edits save via PATCH /drivers/:id with the JSON preference fields. Use Formik for the form with Yup validation (each lane requires originState + destState, each no-go requires state).
acceptanceCriteria: Preferences tab renders inside DriverDetailPage when 'Preferences' tab is selected

Preferred Lanes section: table showing origin state -> dest state with optional city columns, each row has a Remove button, '+ Add Lane' button adds empty row with state select dropdowns + optional city text fields
Lane state fields use select dropdowns with US state abbreviations (2-letter codes)
No-Go Zones section: rendered as removable chips (red-tinted per design), each showing state name; '+ Add' button opens inline select for state + optional city text field
Home Base section: city text field + state select dropdown (pre-filled from driver data)
Max Days Out: number input with range 1-14 (default 5)
Save button triggers PATCH /api/v1/drivers/:id with updated preferredLanes JSON array and noGoZones JSON array
Yup validation: each lane entry requires originState and destState; each no-go entry requires state; maxDaysOut between 1 and 14
Success: notistack toast 'Driver preferences updated'; Error: toast with error message
Loading state shown during save; form disabled while saving
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
